title: New Harbor: A City of Shadows
short_summary: In rain-soaked New Harbor, Detective Jack unravels a web of lies and desperation. Veronica, haunted by loss, confesses her role in the city's latest tragedy, revealing the lengths she'll go to for love and survival.
world_context: A gritty, noir-inspired city in the late 1940s, where rain never stops and secrets fester in the shadows. Neon lights flicker over rain-slicked streets, and every apartment hides a story.

characters.name: Jack
characters.physical_traits: Tall, lean build, sharp jawline, perpetual five o'clock shadow, piercing blue eyes, short dark hair
quirks: Always wears a rumpled trench coat
characters.typical_attire: Dark trench coat, white dress shirt, loosened tie, fedora hat, scuffed leather shoes
characters.backstory: Jack is a seasoned detective hardened by years in New Harbor's underbelly. Haunted by past failures, he is relentless in his pursuit of the truth, even when it costs him personally.
characters.motivations: Driven by justice and a need to protect the innocent, but struggles with guilt and the moral ambiguity of his work.

characters.name: Veronica
characters.physical_traits: Slender, elegant, wavy black hair to shoulders, pale skin, striking green eyes, always perfectly made-up
characters.typical_attire: Black silk dress, pearl necklace, dark heels, tailored overcoat
characters.backstory: Veronica is a survivor of New Harbor's tragedies, having lost her husband Eddie once before. She is fiercely protective, willing to cross lines to keep her loved ones safe.
characters.motivations: Desperate to protect her family, even if it means lying or breaking the law. Haunted by guilt and fear of loss.

chapters.chapter_summary: Jack confronts Veronica in her rain-soaked apartment. Under pressure, Veronica confesses her lies and desperate actions to protect Eddie. The emotional confrontation leaves both changed, and Veronica decides she can no longer stay in New Harbor.

scenes.scene_description: Rain pours over the city as Jack arrives at Veronica's building, setting the tense, noir mood.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Establishing shot of a rain-soaked city block at night. Veronica's apartment building looms, neon signs reflecting in puddles, rain streaking down grimy windows. Streetlights cast long shadows across the wet pavement. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Setting the rainy, oppressive mood outside Veronica's building.

dialogue.text: Rain hammered New Harbor, washing secrets down the gutter.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Medium shot of Jack, trench coat slick with rain, standing beneath the apartment's awning. He glances up at a lit window, cigarette smoke curling in the damp air. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack pauses outside, gathering resolve before entering.

dialogue.text: Jack braced himself for the storm inside.

pages.page_description: Establishes the rainy city and Jack's arrival at Veronica's building.

scenes.scene_description: Jack enters Veronica's dimly lit apartment. The tension is palpable as he confronts her with evidence.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Wide shot of Veronica's living room, shadows stretching across the floor. Veronica stands near the window, backlit by city lights and rain. Jack enters, water dripping from his coat. Portrait 4:5.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Medium shot of Jack holding up a lipstick-stained glass and a small pistol wrapped in a handkerchief. Veronica stands opposite, tense, her hands clenched. Rain streaks the window behind her. Portrait 4:5.

dialogue.text: You want to explain these, Veronica?

panels.color_palette: muted reds, cold blues, harsh white highlights

important_objects.label: man in trench coat holding glass and pistol

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Close-up of Veronica's face, mascara streaked by tears, eyes wide with fear and exhaustion. The city lights blur behind her. Portrait 4:5.

dialogue.text: I lied. I tried to bribe Tommy after I found out what he did.

panels.color_palette: pale skin, dark hair, smeared black mascara, neon reflections

pages.page_description: Jack confronts Veronica with evidence; her mask begins to slip.

scenes.scene_description: Veronica confesses her actions and motivations, breaking down emotionally. Jack listens, torn between duty and empathy.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Medium shot of Veronica, shoulders shaking, clutching her arms. Jack stands in the background, softened by shadow. Rain patterns streak the window glass. Portrait 4:5.

dialogue.text: I hid the gun. I couldn't let them take Eddie from me again.

panels.color_palette: muted blues, pale skin, black dress, golden city lights

important_objects.label: woman in black dress clutching arms

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Close-up of Jack's face, softened, eyes reflecting regret and empathy. Dim lamplight highlights the rain on his cheek. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack's expression softens as he listens.

dialogue.text: We do what we must. But the truth matters, Veronica.

panels.color_palette: pale blue, warm gold, dark hair, shadowed features

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Close-up of Veronica's trembling hands, one clutching a crumpled handkerchief, the other wiping away tears. Dim light glints off her pearl bracelet. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Veronica wipes away tears, hands shaking.

dialogue.text: I was scared. I thought I could control it all. But New Harbor chews us up.

pages.page_description: Veronica's confession and Jack's empathetic response, focusing on emotional details.

scenes.scene_description: After the confession, Veronica turns away from Jack, deciding she cannot stay in New Harbor any longer.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Print Comic Noir Style. Medium shot of Veronica turning away from Jack, her silhouette framed by the open doorway to the hallway. Jack stands in the shadows, watching her go. Rain continues to streak the window. Portrait 4:5.

dialogue.text: I can't stay here. Not anymore.
